name: No-change
operational_definition: Return the control/basal input expression without perturbation-specific delta
applies_to: All audits where control/basal input exists

name: Global perturbed mean
operational_definition: Predict the global mean perturbed training response, independent of target

name: Context-matched perturbed mean
operational_definition: Predict a context-specific perturbed mean when context metadata are available; fallback to global mean

name: Additive component baseline
operational_definition: Sum available component perturbation deltas from training data; fallback to mean effect when components are unavailable
exclusion_or_caveat: B3 is not used for Replogle essential-screen analyses because component information is absent

name: PCA/Ridge
operational_definition: Fit low-capacity ridge regression on perturbation feature vectors/PCA components
applies_to: Norman/Replogle when enough training targets exist

name: Mean-effect
operational_definition: Predict mean training effect as a target-blind response structure baseline
